## Checklist
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `dev`
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, tests and build pass locally
- [ ] New or changed logic is covered by tests
- [ ] UI: keyboard navigation, visible focus, contrast AA, tested at 375 / 768 / 1024 / 1440px
- [ ] i18n: all user-facing strings translated (ro / ru)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, logs or commits
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, decisions log) if needed
